description: Record a signup for this program and bind the customer to the affiliate click that brought them, so their later sales attribute from customerExternalId alone. Use it when a referred visitor creates an account, from your server. Send customerExternalId, clickId, or both. Returns { ok, status, data } from the API, or an error naming what is missing.

clickId.description: The click id the Affitor tracker stored in the visitor's affitor_click_id cookie. Send it, customerExternalId, or both; with neither, the lead cannot be attributed.

customerExternalId.description: Your app's own id for this customer, such as user_123. It binds the customer to the click, so their later sales need only this id. Send it, clickId, or both.

email.description: The customer's email address, stored with the lead. Leave it out to record the lead without one.

testMode.description: True records a test lead (marked is_test, never counted or paid) while you check an integration. Leave it out to record a real lead.

name: affitor_track_lead
